title: Training
summary: --Training of (May Subd Geog) and --In-service training (May Subd Geog) are free-floating under occupational groups and types of employees, including Teachers and types of teachers (language, literature, and other teachers). --Education is used under occupational groups only for general education or subjects unrelated to the occupation. Employees--Training of is the general heading for on-the-job training. --Teacher training was removed from the free-floating list in 1988 and is used (established individually) only under Religious education and types of religious education.
validation_rules: `--Training of` (May Subd Geog) is free-floating under headings for occupational groups and types of employees. (H 2217 sec. 1.a)

`--Training of` (May Subd Geog) is free-floating under `Teachers`, `Language teachers`, `Language arts teachers`, and headings for specific types of teachers, e.g. `English teachers--Training of--Southern States`, `Mathematics teachers--Training of--France`. (H 2217 sec. 1.b-c)
For training teachers of a language to foreign speakers, also assign `[...] language--Study and teaching--Foreign speakers`. (H 2217 sec. 1.b)

`--Teacher training` is no longer free-floating under topical headings (removed 1988); do not use `[topic]--Teacher training` except under `Religious education` and types of religious education. (H 2217 background, sec. 1.c, 3)

`--Teacher training` (May Subd Geog) under `Religious education` and types of religious education (e.g. `Christian education--Teacher training`) is not free-floating and must be established for each use. (H 2217 sec. 3)

`--Education` (May Subd Geog) under occupational groups and types of employees is only for their general education or education on subjects unrelated to the occupation (cf. H 1579); occupational preparation takes `--Training of`. (H 2217 sec. 1.d)
`Employees--Training of` (May Subd Geog) is the general heading for on-the-job training of employees. (H 2217 sec. 2.a)
`--In-service training` (May Subd Geog) is free-floating under occupational groups and types of employees, e.g. `College teachers--In-service training--United States`. (H 2217 sec. 2.b)

sections.heading: a. General
sections.text: Assign the free-floating subdivision --Training of (May Subd Geog) under headings for occupational groups and types of employees to works on the history and/or methods of instructing persons to prepare them for their occupation.

sections.heading: b. Language and literature teachers
sections.text:
Assign the free-floating subdivision --Training of (May Subd Geog) under the headings Language teachers, Language arts teachers, and headings for types of teachers of language and literature. Examples:

```
650 #0 $a English teachers $x Training of $z Southern States.
650 #0 $a French teachers $x Training of $z Canada.
```

For works on the training of teachers who provide language instruction to foreign speakers, assign an additional heading of the type [...] language--Study and teaching--Foreign speakers.

sections.heading: c. Other teachers
sections.text:
Use the free-floating subdivision --Training of (May Subd Geog) under Teachers and under headings for specific types of teachers to works on the history and/or methods of instructing teachers to prepare them for their work. Examples:

```
650 #0 $a Mathematics teachers $x Training of $z France.
650 #0 $a Science teachers $x Training of $z New Jersey.
```

The practice of assigning --Teacher training as a free-floating subdivision under topical headings has been discontinued.

sections.heading: d. --Training of vs. --Education
sections.text:
Assign the subdivision --Education (May Subd Geog) as a free-floating subdivision under occupational groups and types of employees only to works on the general education of these groups or education on special subjects not related to their occupation (cf. H 1579). Example:

```
Title: Political education in the Southern Farmers' Alliance, 1877-1900.
610 20 $a National Farmers' Alliance and Industrial Union $x History.
650 #0 $a Farmers $z Southern States $x Political activity $x History $y 19th century.
650 #0 $a Farmers $x Education $z Southern States $x History $y 19th century.
650 #0 $a Civics $x Study and teaching $z Southern States $x History $y 19th century.
650 #0 $a Populism $z Southern States $x History $y 19th century.
```

sections.heading: a. General
sections.text: Assign the heading Employees--Training of (May Subd Geog) to general works on training given to employees on the job to help them maintain and upgrade their skills.

sections.heading: b. Special
sections.text: Assign the free-floating subdivision --In-service training (May Subd Geog) under occupational groups and types of employees to works on the history and/or methods of providing training for these groups on the job, for example, College teachers--In-service training--United States.

sections.heading: 3. --Teacher training
sections.text:
Assign the subdivision --Teacher training (May Subd Geog) under Religious education and headings for particular types of religious education to works on the history and methods of training paid employees or volunteers to provide religious instruction in Sunday schools, schools, adult religious education programs, etc.

This subdivision is not free-floating and must be established in the subject authority file for each use.

sections.heading: 4. Examples
sections.text:
```
Title: Employer involvement in schemes of unified vocational preparation.
650 #0 $a Employees $x Training of $z Great Britain.
650 #0 $a Occupational training $z Great Britain.

Title: Guide to training needs assessment.
650 #0 $a Training needs.
650 #0 $a Employees $x Training of.

Title: Diffusion of innovations among training colleges in India.
650 #0 $a Teachers $x Training of $z India.
650 #0 $a Educational innovations $z India.

Title: Teachers in the arts in Louisiana.
650 #0 $a Art teachers $x Training of $z Louisiana.
650 #0 $a Art teachers $x In-service training $z Louisiana.
650 #0 $a Arts $x Study and teaching $z Louisiana.

Title: Developing leadership for the church's teaching ministry.
650 #0 $a Christian education $x Teacher training $v Handbooks, manuals, etc.
650 #0 $a Christian leadership $v Handbooks, manuals, etc.
```
